definition: The broad goal and set of techniques for ensuring an AI system's behavior matches human intentions, values, and safety requirements.
details: Alignment research spans technical work (like RLHF and Constitutional AI) as well as broader questions about how to specify, verify, and maintain desired behavior in increasingly capable systems.
story: Imagine a new medicine that works brilliantly in the lab but still has to be tested on real people before anyone takes it. Boil it down and it is this: The broad goal and set of techniques for ensuring an AI system's behavior matches human intentions, values, and safety requirements. Here is why it matters: Alignment research spans technical work (like RLHF and Constitutional AI) as well as broader questions about how to specify, verify, and maintain desired behavior in increasingly capable systems. Rules and red-teaming are the brakes that make the speed trustworthy. That deliberate caution is Alignment.
